Global Engagement: Completed onsite assignments in the Netherlands (2023 & 2025), directly collaborating with end users and business stakeholders. Deal Setup &

Configuration — Bilateral and Syndicated deal structures, multi-lender arrangements, agent and non-agent roles, deal amendment workflows, and deal-level accounting setup. Facility Management — Revolving Credit Facilities (RCF), Term Loans (TL/TLA/TLB), Sub-limits, Swinglines, Letter of Credit (LC) facilities, facility fee configuration, and maturity management. Outstandings & Drawdowns — Loan booking, drawdown processing, repayment scheduling, rollover management, prepayments, and maturity extensions across multi-currency portfolios. End-to-End Ownership: Delivered complete change lifecycle including requirements, testing, documentation, release, and aftercare support. Entity Onboarding & Migration: Led end-to-end entity onboardings and system migrations, ensuring seamless cutover, structured post–go-live aftercare, and zero business disruption. Data Validation: Used SQL and Excel for reconciliation, impact analysis, and reporting accuracy.

Agile Delivery: Managed backlogs, sprint ceremonies, and releases using Azure DevOps and Agile methodologies. Recognition: Received multiple awards including Cheers Coral, Working As One, Doing the Right Thing, and Constant Performer (Bronze) for delivery excellence. Dec’18 – Feb’22 |Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance Co. Ltd. | Pune Assistant Manager – Finance / Business Analyst, Inhouse projects Key Responsibilities:- PAS Transformation: Served as Finance SME for PAS system migration, ensuring financial integrity and regulatory compliance. Product Enablement: Owned finance validations for new life insurance products including Term, Endowment, Whole Life, Annuity, Pension, Traditional, ULIP, Group Products and product modifications of existing products as per IRDA, securing approvals from Financial Controllers. Regulatory Compliance: Managed reconciliations, fund flows, and ledgers in line with IRDA

Banking Operations: Managed loans, accounts, and customer servicing. Credit Exposure: Gained hands-on experience in credit appraisal, MSME finance, and financial statement analysis. Audit Support: Assisted in internal and external audits. Financial Statement Analysis: Analyzed borrower balance sheets, P&L, and cash flows to assess creditworthiness, repayment capacity, and regulatory compliance. Stock Statement Analysis: Reviewed and validated periodic stock statements to monitor drawing power, inventory movement, and early warning signals for credit risk. ITSM Migration: Led

finance process transition and supported production rollout. E-Forum Systems Pvt ltd – Enterprise Delivery: Delivered budgeting modules, Release and script Management KEY ACHIEVEMENTS Production Excellence: Resolved complex data quality issues independently and successfully deployed fixes to production, completed entity onboarding and migration (Cognizant). UAT Leadership: Led and completed UAT for multiple insurance products, enabling smooth production deployments (Bajaj Allianz). Transformation Delivery: Successfully delivered ITSM migration as lead (Bajaj Allianz). Modernization Impact: Led web transformation of legacy financial modules as BA & Test Lead (E-Forum Systems). PERSONAL DETAILS
